position: A binding plan may name where secrets belong but must never contain their values
headline: The contract shows what a provider must bind while keeping every secret absent from the repository.
copy: Only three managed names are accepted. References are validated, then removed from the founder-safe output so no path or value leaks into the interface.

postures.title: Binding validator
postures.copy: Exactly three allowlisted names and scopes are enforced.

postures.title: Secret references
postures.copy: Validated references never appear in safe output.

postures.title: Rotation
postures.copy: Each owner must rotate within ninety days.

postures.title: Provider binding
postures.copy: The plan has no external side effect.

flow.title: Name
flow.copy: Use the three approved environment binding names.

flow.title: Scope
flow.copy: Map each name to one narrow runtime purpose.

flow.title: Own
flow.copy: Assign a rotation owner and interval.

flow.title: Redact
flow.copy: Return metadata without reference paths or values.

decisions.label: Session signing
decisions.reason: One binding is reserved for private session integrity.

decisions.label: Reviewer store
decisions.reason: One binding protects future reviewer persistence.

decisions.label: Queue integrity
decisions.reason: One binding protects durable event verification.

decisions.label: Secret values
decisions.reason: Literal or unknown value-bearing keys are rejected.

locks.title: Credential lock
locks.copy: No secret value or reviewer credential is generated.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No external account, runtime, endpoint, or domain is created.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: The decision surfaces cannot issue an invitation.

locks.title: Participant lock
locks.copy: No external participant or public session exists.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private implementation evidence cannot open public launch.
